items.title: 14.12 Experiments and data collection to test a hypothesis about air quality (hypothesis test karne ke liye experiment aur data) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.12, printed page 317.

blocks.text: Air quality ke bare mein kisi hypothesis (andaza jise test kiya jaye) ko test karne ke liye experiment design karne mein careful planning, data collection (data jama karna) aur analysis (jaiza) shamil hain. Air quality ke liye yeh steps kiye jate hain:

Pehle step mein experiment design karne ke liye ek hypothesis banai jati hai. Misal: “Shehri ilaqon mein hawa ke particulate matter (PM 2.5) aur nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) ki concentration rush (peak) traffic ke hours mein baqi hours se zyada hoti hai.” Is hypothesis ko din ke different times par air quality ka data jama kar ke test kiya ja sakta hai.

Experiment ki detail plan ki jati hai, jaise variables (badalne wali cheezein) aur data jama karne ka tareeqa. Monitoring ke liye busy sarkon ki jagahein aur residential (rehne wale) ilaqe chune jate hain.

Rush hours aur non-rush hours mein traffic volume (kitni gariyan) ka data jama kiya jata hai aur aakhir mein compare (muqabla) kiya jata hai. Air quality ka data jama karne ke liye reliable (bharose wale) instruments aur tareeqe istemal kiye jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek experiment design karein jo yeh jaanche ke bhatti (brick kiln) ke qareeb PM2.5 us jagah se zyada hai ya nahi jo hawa ki direction ke ulat 2 km door hai.
blocks.explanation: Hypothesis: bhatti ke qareeb PM2.5 zyada hai. Do jagahein chunein: ek bhatti se 200 m hawa ki direction mein aur ek 2 km ulat taraf, dono ek hi oonchai par. Dono jagah ek jaisa calibrated PM sensor ya nephelometer lagayein; do hafte rozana ek hi waqt par readings lein, hawa ki direction aur bhatti ke chalne ka record rakhein; phir dono jagahon ki average readings ka muqabla karein.

items: Air quality ki hypothesis test karna: hypothesis banayein (rush hours mein PM2.5 aur NO₂ zyada); experiment design karein (variables, jagahein); data jama kar ke muqabla karein.
